items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And the bass teacher was also Robert Bernand.

ctx.x: So it wasn't I need a master's degree because I'm gonna be a teacher or anything like that?

No … that's probably way back here somewhere in everybody's mind about an alternative employment, but that wasn't my focus. I just thought that I can go to school free, man, let's just take this gig. And it was a good school. It is a good school. It was then too. Third Avenue and 103rd Street, something like that at the time. And the bass teacher was also Robert Bernand.
